visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with red-tinted hair and a grey scarf holds a crying toddler girl in a pink vest outdoors. The girl holds a yellow baby bottle. In the background, a grey concrete school building and various parents with backpacks are visible under overcast daylight. (2) The scene cuts to the woman sitting on a wooden bench, embracing both the toddler and a young boy wearing a blue Stitch-themed hoodie. The boy is crying and rubbing his eyes while the woman speaks to him with a comforting expression. (3) The group walks along a concrete path towards a parked bus. The boy clings to the woman's side. Several other school-aged children with rolling luggage and backpacks pass by, heading towards the vehicle. (4) They reach a large green and white tour bus labeled with school text. The woman gives the boy a long, tight hug by the bus door before he boards. The woman waves as the bus prepares to depart from the school grounds.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the high-pitched, distressed crying of a young child. The primary female voice speaks in a low-arousal, soothing tone in Mandarin. No music is present yet. (2) A gentle, emotional piano melody starts to fade in. The sound of a boy whimpering and sniffling becomes prominent, mixed with the woman's quiet whispers of encouragement. (3) Ambient outdoor noise increases as the group moves. Sounds of footsteps on pavement and the low-frequency rumble of a large bus engine are audible. The BGM maintains a steady, sentimental pace. (4) The music swells slightly in volume as the mother says a final goodbye. A short mechanical hiss from the bus door occurs, followed by the fading chatter of the crowd as the video concludes.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share the emotional experience of a young child leaving for their first independent school overnight trip. The video focuses on the family's bonding and the bittersweet moment of goodbye.
